text: Staying out of it feels safe. Five hundred years ago, one man disagreed.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Ancient Greece. King Antiochus comes to drive out Rome. Both send envoys to the Achaeans.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Team meeting. Two plans. Both leads look at you... you say, both are good.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli, bluntly... irresolute princes, to avoid present dangers, generally follow the neutral path, and are generally ruined.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Is picking a side safe? No path is perfectly safe, he admits. Choose the lesser risk... eyes open.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
